research_question: In adults with active systemic lupus erythematosus, does belimumab at the standard approved dose (10 mg/kg IV or 200 mg SC weekly) compared with placebo (both plus standard therapy) increase the proportion of patients achieving at least a 4-point reduction in the SELENA-SLEDAI score at 52 weeks?
treatment_label: Belimumab at approved dose (10 mg/kg IV monthly or 200 mg SC weekly) plus standard therapy
outcome_description: Dichotomous responder outcome: number of participants achieving a reduction of at least 4 points from baseline in the SELENA-SLEDAI (SLEDAI) disease activity score at 52 weeks, with the total number of participants analysed in each arm. Only this single dichotomous SELENA-SLEDAI ≥4-point reduction endpoint is extracted; the composite SLE Responder Index (SRI-4), continuous SELENA-SLEDAI change scores, BILAG indices, physician global assessment, quality of life, glucocorticoid tapering, adverse events, infections, withdrawals, and mortality are not extracted.
positive_direction: A positive effect (RR greater than 1 / positive Hedges g) means more patients on belimumab than on placebo achieved at least a 4-point reduction in SELENA-SLEDAI at 52 weeks, i.e. belimumab improved disease activity.
search_queries: belimumab systemic lupus erythematosus randomized placebo-controlled trial 52 weeks
belimumab 10 mg/kg intravenous SLEDAI reduction lupus trial outcome
belimumab 200 mg subcutaneous lupus disease activity randomized controlled trial efficacy
inclusion_criteria: Randomised controlled trial in adults with active systemic lupus erythematosus
Compares belimumab (any route, including the approved 10 mg/kg IV or 200 mg SC regimens) with placebo, both on top of standard therapy
Reports, in the paper or its supplement, the number of participants achieving at least a 4-point reduction in SELENA-SLEDAI/SLEDAI at or around 52 weeks and the number analysed per arm
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic review, meta-analysis, pooled/network analysis, editorial, opinion piece, narrative review, theoretical paper, trial protocol without results, conference abstract without data)
No comparison between a belimumab arm and a placebo/control arm (single-arm, open-label extension without control, observational or non-randomised design)
No quantitative outcome data permitting effect-size calculation for the dichotomous SELENA-SLEDAI ≥4-point reduction at 52 weeks (no event counts or proportions with denominators)
Completely unrelated to belimumab in systemic lupus erythematosus (e.g. other diseases, other biologics only, paediatric-only populations, or lupus nephritis renal-response-only endpoints)
moderators_to_extract: Belimumab route and regimen (10 mg/kg IV vs 200 mg SC)
Geographic region / trial population (e.g. North America-Europe, Asia, Latin America)
Baseline SELENA-SLEDAI disease activity (mean or proportion ≥10)
Publication year and risk-of-bias / funding source (industry-sponsored vs other)
effect_size_note: Extract 2x2 event counts (responders achieving ≥4-point SELENA-SLEDAI reduction / total analysed) for the approved-dose belimumab arm and the placebo arm, and pool as a risk ratio (RR) with a random-effects model. In multi-dose trials use only the 10 mg/kg IV arm (or the 200 mg SC arm when that is the trial's regimen); discard 1 mg/kg and other non-approved doses so each trial contributes a single independent comparison. Use the 52-week (or nearest reported ~week 48-52) timepoint only.
